metadata.title: Clicked like a dizzy pigeon and somehow snagged 1 kill? Valorant’s chaos just delivered!
metadata.description:
Me: flapping around like I forgot what crosshair means
Enemy: probably thinking ‘Did that just happen?’
Valorant handing out kills like it’s a glitch party
Click if your aim’s a beautiful mess too!

Tap if your panic clicks ever surprise everyone!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
